title: A billed key makes an image with Gemini

beats.speaker: dtrain
beats.text: olisar can you make an image of a red panda in a little astronaut suit

notes: Billing only: on a key with billing on and Make images with Gemini on, generate_image should use gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image (about $0.034) and post the image. On a free key it needs Cloudflare. Check the instance log for the image model and the attachment on Olisar's message.
